title: Counting Sort Prefix-Sum Loop
statement: The prefix-sum step of counting sort is the loop over all bucket indices that replaces the count at each index plus one with the sum of the counts at that index and the next index.
caveat: The loop range and the definitions of the memory and variable notation are omitted, so the precise iteration bounds and indexed cells are unclear.
